docker.description: The container CLI; podman also works.

image.description: Your image, used for every agent and never built. Default: the shipped image, built on first use.

mounts.description: Extra absolute host paths, mounted read-only at the same path.

network.description: host shares the host network; allowlist routes the run through the conductor's proxy.

allow.description: Allowlist mode: hosts the run may reach, exact or *.suffix.
